item.title: So-called Prediction Market
item.description:
No doubt, Robinhood’s prediction market is designed to attract people and get them addicted. In some ways, it’s like online fentanyl. However, don’t feel surprised, online gambling has almost conquered this country.

Never ask Robinhood why they publicly release such a gambling product; never tell a Robinhood online representative you’re addicted to their so-called prediction market – another way to say gambling, Robinhood support might suggest you call the National Gambling Helpline. It is very ironic, because Robinhood has designed a very addictive product and sends you ads for their online gambling service every day, and when you’re addicted, they say the National Gambling Helpline is available for you, and they’re going to take good care of you.

item.title: Water Leak
item.description:
Water Leak In recent months, I have gotten several notices from the City’s Water and Sewer Division saying I might have a leak.

My water bills rose to $500/month, but I still haven’t found a plumber to deal with it.

I’m kind of like a hamster refusing to leave its tiny den on a small island – stuck, and not doing anything to change the situation.
